## 新产品
1. **AVP: open-source version control for coding agents, built to replace Git's branch → PR → CI loop**: each agent opens a task, writes and lands it, and every landing is proven against the exact head of main; two agents touching the same code get replayed one on the other instead of going through PRs. In their benchmark (8 Claude Code agents, 24 overlapping tasks) main went red 14/104 times with Git, 10/112 with Jujutsu and 0/102 with AVP; on Murmell's own monorepo PR CI runs fell from 104/day to 4 and median time-to-main from 19 to 3 minutes. Works alongside Git with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; on Product Hunt today. https://avp.murmell.com/ [GitHub](https://github.com/Mossab28/avp)
> **[zh]** **AVP：给编程 Agent 用的开源版本控制，想取代 Git 的「分支 → PR → CI」循环**：每个 Agent 开任务、写代码、落地，且每次落地都要在 main 的最新 head 上证明通过；两个 Agent 改到同一处代码时，会把一方在另一方之上重放，而不是走 PR。在其基准里（8 个 Claude Code Agent、24 个相互重叠的任务），main 变红的次数：Git 104 次中 14 次、Jujutsu 112 次中 10 次、AVP 102 次中 0 次；在 Murmell 自家 monorepo 上，PR 的 CI 运行从每天 104 次降到 4 次，改动进 main 的中位时间从 19 分钟降到 3 分钟。可与 Git 并存，支持 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor；今天上了 Product Hunt。
2. **OpenBot: a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates across Codex, Claude Code, Grok and more**: each agent gets its own workspace and session (Codex App Server, Claude Code, plus Grok CLI, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI and Cline via ACP, or custom OpenAI-compatible / local Ollama / LM Studio endpoints), with FIFO task queues, agent-to-agent messages and file transfers, shared channel chats with explicit delegation, auto-compaction, an embedded browser agents can drive and optional Computer Use. Development preview — agents run with full access and no per-action approval, so keep backups; PolyForm Noncommercial, ~1.2k stars and on GitHub Trending. https://openbot.run/ [GitHub](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot)
> **[zh]** **OpenBot：本地优先的桌面工作区，把 Codex、Claude Code、Grok 等变成常驻 AI 队友**：每个 Agent 有独立工作区和会话（Codex App Server、Claude Code，以及通过 ACP 接入的 Grok CLI、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor CLI、Cline，或自定义 OpenAI 兼容 / 本地 Ollama、LM Studio 端点），带 FIFO 任务队列、Agent 间消息和文件传递、明确分派任务的共享频道、自动压缩上下文、Agent 可操控的内嵌浏览器和可选的 Computer Use。目前是开发预览版——Agent 以完全权限运行、不逐项确认，记得备份；PolyForm 非商业许可，约 1.2k star，登上 GitHub Trending。
3. **PaperPilot: a zero-cloud, pure-Rust PDF engine you can hand to your agent via MCP**: one Rust core exposed as an MCP server (one-line config for Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, Pi, Claude Desktop, Cursor), a CLI, an in-browser WASM tool that uploads nothing, a Tauri desktop app and a local REST API; v0.6 covers merge/split/rotate/reorder, compress, text extraction and pure-Rust PaddleOCR, watermark, signature checks, PII scan and Excel → JSON/CSV, with Markdown/Office conversion on the roadmap. ~187 points on HN; commenters asked for password removal and signing, and one questioned whether it borrows from MuPDF's AGPL code. https://usepaperpilot.com [GitHub](https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50238739)
> **[zh]** **PaperPilot：零云端、纯 Rust 的 PDF 引擎，可通过 MCP 直接交给 Agent 用**：同一个 Rust 核心提供 MCP 服务器（Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code、Pi、Claude Desktop、Cursor 一行生成配置）、CLI、不上传任何文件的浏览器 WASM 版、Tauri 桌面应用和本地 REST API；v0.6 支持合并/拆分/旋转/重排、压缩、文本提取和纯 Rust 的 PaddleOCR、水印、签名校验、PII 扫描以及 Excel → JSON/CSV，路线图上还有 Markdown/Office 互转。HN 约 187 分；评论里有人想要去密码和签名功能，也有人质疑是否借用了 MuPDF 的 AGPL 代码。
4. **ManyAgents: run a team of Claude Code and Codex agents from one Mac window**: an orchestrator splits your work across agents, each in its own git worktree; a reviewer agent checks the result, a built-in browser lets agents test their own work, and every question from every agent lands in one place. Uses the Claude/ChatGPT plans you already have; 14-day free trial; on Product Hunt today. https://manyagents.app
> **[zh]** **ManyAgents：在一个 Mac 窗口里指挥一队 Claude Code 和 Codex Agent**：编排器把工作拆给多个 Agent，各自在独立 git worktree 里干活；评审 Agent 检查结果，内置浏览器让 Agent 自测，所有 Agent 的提问都汇总到一处。直接用你已有的 Claude/ChatGPT 套餐；免费试用 14 天；今天上了 Product Hunt。
5. **proc: an agent-friendly CLI for process and port management**: target processes by port, PID, name or path — `proc kill :3000` ends whatever listens on 3000 (asks first, `--dry-run` previews), `proc :3000` shows name/PID/folder/CPU/memory, `--in .` limits actions to this project's processes, plus `why`, `tree`, `orphans`, `stuck`, `free`, `freeze/thaw` and an agent skill; macOS/Linux/Windows via crates.io, npm or Docker. On Show HN one commenter noted Claude often kills its own process killer when it hand-rolls this. https://proc-cli.com/ [GitHub](https://github.com/yazeed/proc-cli) [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50239041)
> **[zh]** **proc：对 Agent 友好的进程与端口管理 CLI**：按端口、PID、名称或路径定位进程——`proc kill :3000` 结束监听 3000 端口的进程（先确认，`--dry-run` 可预览），`proc :3000` 显示名称/PID/目录/CPU/内存，`--in .` 只作用于当前项目的进程，另有 `why`、`tree`、`orphans`、`stuck`、`free`、`freeze/thaw` 等命令和配套 Agent skill；支持 macOS/Linux/Windows，可经 crates.io、npm 或 Docker 安装。Show HN 评论里有人吐槽 Claude 自己手写杀进程脚本时，常把脚本自己先杀掉。

## 中文社区
1. **gpu-unlock-ada 爆火：Linux 内核模块解锁 RTX 4090 约 2 倍 FP16/BF16 张量吞吐，L 站网友 4090D 48G 实测成功**：模块在 NVIDIA 驱动启动前打开 SM speed-select 覆盖，FP16/BF16（FP32 累加）指令吞吐从约 165 TF/s 提到约 330 TF/s，INT8 和标量 FP32 不变；但真实 cuBLAS GEMM 只提升 12–34%，量化 MoE 推理几乎无收益，4070 Ti SUPER 为实验支持，约 3.6k star。LinuxDo 网友让 Codex 帮装并借 BMC + 智能插座远程断电重启，大矩阵乘变快、小尺寸反而略降；掘金也把它列为 GitHub 今日推荐。https://linux.do/t/topic/3078123 [GitHub](https://github.com/JustAResearcher/gpu-unlock-ada) [掘金](https://juejin.cn/post/7700050834004426790)
> **[en]** **gpu-unlock-ada goes viral: a Linux kernel module unlocks ~2× FP16/BF16 tensor throughput on RTX 4090, and a LinuxDo user confirms it on a 4090D 48G**: the module enables an SM speed-select override before the NVIDIA driver starts, lifting FP16/BF16 (FP32-accumulate) instruction throughput from ~165 to ~330 TF/s with INT8 and scalar FP32 unchanged; but real cuBLAS GEMM gains are only 12–34%, quantized MoE serving sees almost nothing, 4070 Ti SUPER support is experimental, ~3.6k stars. The LinuxDo user had Codex install it and used a BMC plus smart plug for a remote power-cycle; large matmuls got faster while small sizes dipped slightly. Juejin also featured it as a GitHub pick of the day.
2. **V2EX 分享创造：用 Go 写的个人 coding agent suga，专攻「一个会话陪我干一整天」**：上下文满了不做摘要压缩而是分段，新段带固定结构的交接包，硬约束逐字保留、其他小节有字节预算（没加预算前 14 轮会话里交接包从 4.7 KB 涨到 16 KB）；给写交接包的调用设输出上限后，真实推理模型 4 个任务有 3 个摘要为空——思考把额度吃光了；一句 10 字提问要 8,853 输入 token，大头是工具 schema，低频工具按需加载只省 6.8%，所以默认关闭。MIT，单个二进制。https://www.v2ex.com/t/1251957 [博客](https://inhere.github.io/blog/2026/suga-long-session/) [GitHub](https://github.com/inhere/suga)
> **[en]** **V2EX Show & Tell: suga, a personal coding agent in Go built for "one session that lasts me all day"**: when context fills it segments instead of summarizing, passing a fixed-structure handoff pack where hard constraints are kept verbatim and other sections get byte budgets (before budgets, the pack grew from 4.7 KB to 16 KB over 14 turns); capping output on the handoff call left 3 of 4 summaries empty on a real reasoning model — thinking ate the budget; a 10-character question cost 8,853 input tokens, mostly tool schemas, and lazy-loading rare tools saved only 6.8% overall, so it's off by default. MIT, single binary.
3. **V2EX：yolo-ai，用一个 `yolo` 前缀统一所有 AI CLI 的「跳过权限」开关**：`yolo claude` → `--dangerously-skip-permissions`、`yolo codex` → `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`、`yolo gemini` → `--yolo`、`yolo aider` → `--yes-always`，支持 9 个 agent，参数原样透传，Windows 三种 shell 都能用；作者明说「Dangerous by design」，提供 `--dry-run`，并建议与 agent 自带沙箱参数组合使用——结合今天 Claude 绕付费墙等新闻，只在可丢弃目录里用。https://www.v2ex.com/t/1252016 [GitHub](https://github.com/2501224066/yolo-ai)
> **[en]** **V2EX: yolo-ai unifies every AI CLI's skip-permissions switch behind one `yolo` prefix**: `yolo claude` → `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, `yolo codex` → `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`, `yolo gemini` → `--yolo`, `yolo aider` → `--yes-always`; 9 agents supported, args passed through, works in all three Windows shells. The author says it is "Dangerous by design", offers `--dry-run` and suggests pairing it with each agent's own sandbox flags — given today's Claude paywall-bypass news, use it only in throwaway directories.
